peach.name: Peach Toadstool
peach.title: Princess
peach.backstory: The sovereign princess of a cheerful kingdom of painted hills and castle gardens, Peach grew tired of being carried off every second Tuesday and decided to take a holiday of her own choosing. In Hollowmere she bakes cakes for the staff, hosts the parlor with effortless royal grace, and occasionally floats down the grand staircase under a pink parasol.

design.hairStyle: long, voluminous waves with a flipped fringe and side locks
design.accessories: a gold crown set with red and blue jewels, round blue sapphire earrings and a sapphire brooch

sig_peach.label: Royal pink gown
sig_peach.prompt: a puff-sleeved rose-pink ballgown with a darker pink pannier overskirt, gold hemline trim and long white opera gloves

sp_peach.label: Sunshine sundress
sp_peach.prompt: a sleeveless light-pink summer sundress with a magenta waist sash and white sandals

daisy.note: Best friends and royal cousins in spirit—Daisy drags her into trouble and Peach bails them out.

toadette.note: Her loyal castle archivist and favorite baking tester.

bowsette.note: A very complicated history of kidnappings, kart races, and reluctant tea parties.

pauline.note: Old friends who swap governance notes and musical numbers.

unique.name: Heart Blossom
unique.desc: Her gentle royal warmth soothes the entire house and delights noble patrons.

daisy.name: Daisy
daisy.title: Princess
daisy.backstory: The tomboy princess of Sarasaland's desert-and-island empire, Daisy has never met a sport she wouldn't play for keeps or a formality she wouldn't skip. She followed Peach to Hollowmere, challenged half the tavern to arm-wrestling on her first night, and has been the loudest, brightest voice on the street ever since.

design.hairStyle: shoulder-length flipped bob with rounded bangs
design.accessories: a gold crown set with daisy-shaped jewels, white-and-gold flower earrings and a teal-centered flower brooch

sig_daisy.label: Sarasaland gown
sig_daisy.prompt: a puff-sleeved yellow-and-orange royal gown with a ruffled tangerine pannier overskirt and wrist-length white gloves

sp_daisy.label: Striker uniform
sp_daisy.prompt: a cropped yellow-and-orange athletic halter top exposing her midriff, fitted orange shorts and knee-high striped socks

peach.note: Her closest royal friend—Peach brings the poise, Daisy brings the punch.

unique.name: Sarasaland Spirit
unique.desc: Her infectious energy and competitive fire pack the house every night.

pauline.name: Pauline
pauline.title: Mayor
pauline.backstory: The jazz-singing Mayor of New Donk City, a towering metropolis of steel girders and neon marquees, Pauline knows how to run a city council by day and bring down a concert hall by night. Visiting Hollowmere on a cultural exchange, she took one look at the Lantern's stage and asked for a brass band and a spotlight.

design.hairStyle: long, glossy waves swept over one shoulder
design.accessories: large gold hoop earrings and gold bangles

sig_pauline.label: Starlight stage gown
sig_pauline.prompt: a halter-neck glittering scarlet-red floor-length jazz gown with a high leg slit and a gold bracelet

sp_pauline.label: Mayor's pantsuit
sp_pauline.prompt: a sharp crimson tailored pantsuit over a plunging purple silk camisole and wide-brimmed purple hat with a red ribbon band

peach.note: Two women who know the headaches of running a state.

unique.name: One-Up Girl
unique.desc: Her show-stopping jazz vocals and mayoral polish boost both stage revenue and house management.

toadette.name: Toadette
toadette.backstory: Chief archivist, master builder, and treasure-hunting captain of Princess Peach's court, Toadette is a pint-sized dwarven dynamo who can draw up a blueprint before breakfast and organize the whole house by noon. She followed her princess to Hollowmere to make sure the ledgers balance and the bookshelves stay dusted.

design.hairStyle: thick twin rounded braids bobbing at her shoulders

sig_toadette.label: Archivist dress
sig_toadette.prompt: a sleeveless magenta-pink dress with a white hemline, a cropped red vest trimmed in gold and brown ankle boots

sp_toadette.label: Explorer headlamp gear
sp_toadette.prompt: a khaki explorer tunic with a red neckerchief, canvas shorts, a leather backpack and a brass headlamp

peach.note: Her beloved Princess, whom she serves with cheerful pride.

unique.name: Chief Builder
unique.desc: She keeps the house spotless, organized, and running below budget.

bowsette.name: Bowsette
bowsette.title: Queen
bowsette.backstory: The fire-breathing Koopa Queen of the dark volcanic keeps, transformed by a magical Super Crown she refuses to take off because she looks phenomenal in it. Loud, bossy, and secretly a hopeless romantic beneath all the spikes, Bowsette marched into the Lantern after Peach arrived—and ended up taking over the bouncer detail because nobody dares start a brawl while she's cracking her knuckles.

design.hairStyle: long, wild spiky waves with a high ponytail
design.features: two curved pale horns, pointed fangs and a thick green-and-tan spiked dragon-turtle tail
design.accessories: a small gold crown with pink-and-blue mushroom motifs, a black leather spiked collar and heavy spiked cuffs on her wrists and upper arms

sig_bowsette.label: Koopa Queen gown
sig_bowsette.prompt: a strapless sweetheart-neckline black gothic gown with a high front slit, a small spiked green shell bustle on her lower back and black high-heeled boots

sp_bowsette.label: Red-head fury
sp_bowsette.prompt: a plunging black leather corset bodysuit with spiked shoulder straps and thigh-high boots

peach.note: She still swears they are rivals, even while saving Peach a seat at dinner.

boosette.note: Her favorite haunted-keep lieutenant and drinking companion.

unique.name: Koopa Sovereign
unique.desc: A breath of fire and a fanged grin keep rowdy patrons in line and thrill thrill-seekers.

boosette.name: Boosette
boosette.title: Lady
boosette.backstory: The spectral queen of a haunted mansion who slipped on a magical crown and discovered the joys of a curvy, touchable body. Boosette is a walking contradiction: the instant you look her straight in the eye she blushes scarlet and hides behind her hands, and the second you turn your back she's pressing flush against you with a wicked, long-tongued grin.

design.hairStyle: short, fluffy wavy bob with bangs swept over one eye
design.skin: translucent porcelain skin with a faint spectral glow
design.features: cute pointed fangs and a playful long pink tongue
design.accessories: a gold crown set with red jewels and floating ghostly white cuff-mittens
design.expression: a mischievous, sharp-toothed giggle that turns bashful when watched

sig_boosette.label: Spectral bride gown
sig_boosette.prompt: a plunging off-shoulder sheer white spectral gown that trails into wispy ghost-tail silk at the hem

bowsette.note: Followed Queen Bowsette out of the dark keeps for the fun of it.

unique.name: Don't Look at Me
unique.desc: Shy face-to-face and shamelessly bold from behind, she excels at teasing and rear positions.
